rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Hall effect keeps expanding beyond gaming boards; IQUNIX's EC75 and Keychron's magnetic-mechanical hybrid Kickstarter both launched this week, reinforcing HE as a baseline feature.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: MX2A is now the default across nearly all retail Cherry switches, but the new Lumina Browns made at Cherry's China facility are drawing mixed community reaction.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Emerald
rows.note: Gateron shipped its first tactile magnetic switch, Jade Emerald, adding software-adjustable actuation to a tactile HE feel for the first time.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: Durock T1 variants remain a staple tactile pick in 2026 roundups, with Sunflower T1 still cited as a top mid-range recommendation.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Lineup and stock unchanged at Gateron, KBDfans, Divinikey since the early-2026 four-switch expansion; still the steady mid-range linear default.

rows.name: GMK CYL Orange Alert
rows.note: GMK CYL Orange Alert opened for group buy Aug 14, running through Sep 14 across Divinikey, KBDfans, UniKeys and Keebz N Cables.

rows.name: GMK CYL TA Neo
rows.note: TA Neo's group buy closed July 17 and the set has moved into production tracking, cooling week-over-week chatter as attention shifts to newer buys.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: Sibling set DCS Molch, part of the same Dolch family, closed its own group buy Aug 23, giving the Dolch family a fresh bump in interest.

rows.name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
rows.note: OG Extensions' group buy closed Aug 12 and the set is now in-stock at zFrontier, the usual post-buy interest cooldown after a strong run.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Split/ergo keeps consolidating as the enthusiast default, reinforced by Keychron's wireless Q11 Ultra and continued Glove80 coverage in 2026 roundups.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Alice still gets cited as the top ergonomic starter layout, but full split boards keep pulling advanced hobbyists further along the ergo path.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: 75% remains the default form factor across new releases from Keychron's Q/V Ultra lines and most custom-kit group buys this cycle.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: The 2026 Sonnet and Encore have fully transitioned from pre-order to in-stock, with new Black Sesame and Forest Mocha colorways now shipping.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Blaine V2: SE's group buy (July 10-Aug 9) sold out and addons are gone too, so attention now shifts to CannonKeys' next project update.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Prototypist's SF60 HE group buy and VS06 kit remain in the pipeline, and it was tapped as a launch vendor for the HyperFuse keyset.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Keychron launched the V6 Ultra Hybrid on Kickstarter Aug 18, mixing mechanical and magnetic switches on one board with $149 early-bird pricing.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: MX2A's near-total takeover of Cherry's catalog is tempered by community debate over the China-made Lumina Brown, the first switch off that line.

rows.name: Topre / HHKB
rows.note: Topre unveiled the Realforce R4 with dual-mode USB-C/Bluetooth connectivity, slated for an Oct 18 Japan launch, reviving electrocapacitive buzz.
